allowed_claim_language: The report shows when fixed external Hasse source terms become visible under named graph-recorded masks.
The aligned operational mask may be compared with speculative-presence and local-coordinate controls.
An unusually monotone radial collapse may be reported as an empirical property of the fixed finite source order.
Reciprocal witness reinforcement may annotate a source without counting its analytic contribution more than once.
disallowed_claim_language: Do not describe source-node presence as operand availability before confirmed_stage.
Do not call fixed-K source reveal a stage-u zeta approximation or runtime zeta calculation.
Do not call the natural n-prefix graph-unique while readiness and reciprocal schedules both equal n.
Do not claim a graph-constructed zero, zero discovery, zero certification, or evidence for the Riemann hypothesis.
Do not treat an inside-envelope reading or exploratory permutation rank as proof.
Do not multiply an external source contribution by its reciprocal witness count.
kill_criteria: Reject the primary reading if the operational terminal mask fails to reconstruct the finite Hasse endpoint.
Reject any claimed computational effect confined to the speculative node-presence mask.
Attribute tail-to-endpoint behavior shared by local controls to the Hasse amplitude envelope.
Reject graph-topology language while confirmed-ready and reciprocal-backed schedules remain identical.
Treat differing matched-prefix schedules as a corpus or instrumentation fault.

method.cancellation_envelope: remaining unarrived L1 mass divided by eta-bridge magnitude; outside means the remaining finite terms cannot reach zero, while inside is necessary but never sufficient

error_model.cutoff_stability: last two named finite-K changes must be below an independent relative stability threshold

method.fixed_basis_warning: the exact A_(K,n) weights use terminal outer rows k=0..K-1 at every graph stage; P_u is not a stage-u Hasse approximation
method.name: fixed_terminal_K_hasse_source_reveal
method.permutation_null: endpoint-preserving permutations of whole contributions inside predeclared adjacent source blocks of sizes 2 and 4
method.primary_mask_rule: source confirmed_stage<=u AND direct retained edge 1/n at stage<=u
method.primary_mask_scope: confirmed-source plus reciprocal-witness gate for external analysis; the reciprocal result is not treated as an operand

source_schedule.scope: retrospective schedule metadata with explicit horizon-censored fields; raw stages after the horizon are not prefix-validated

summary.operational_reciprocal_boundary: the primary mask is an external-analysis gate: source n is confirmed and a retained 1/n edge exists; the reciprocal result itself remains non-operand-ready for n>1
summary.reciprocal_reinforcement_reading: source n receives one retained 1/n witness at each stage divisible by n; reinforcement annotates the node and never duplicates its analytic term

summary.graph_specificity_reading: the completed aligned trajectory is the ordinary n-prefix; no additional graph topology orders the external analytic terms
summary.speculative_presence_reading: source_node_present is a speculative, aperture-conditioned visibility mask; assess any effect only in a matched-aperture comparison and never promote it to runtime computation
summary.tail_capture_reading: local-control tail-to-endpoint captures differ by at most one stage; attribute this near-match to the fixed Hasse amplitude envelope
